answer: An hostile operator running 43 aliases as a result needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in oasis, expire in ripple, and velvet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 37 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
